description: The live NULL manifest: every product (messenger, Pay, Vault, Drop, Legacy, Agent Wire, forward secrecy), its status, its page, the wired/proposed integrations between them, the security spine, and the concept pipeline. This is the same single source of truth the owner console and the human Suite read — a new product that ships appears here automatically. Pair it with null_agent_guide for the how-to. Read-only.
